"""Nominal spectral-band coverage of fixed real cab-reference peaks,not GT scoring."""
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V165-pair-common-v1'
c=next(c for c in read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations'] if c['id']=='mesh-nominal')
assert ref(c['arrays']['path'])==c['arrays'];a=np.load(c['arrays']['path']);records=[]
for window in c['cases']:
 x,y,w,h=window['ROI_xywh'];assert w==h==160
 binding=window['camera_JPEGs']['reference_camera_jpeg']['pixels'];assert ref(binding['path'])==binding
 sources={'ISO100 JPEG mean sRGB code':np.load(binding['path']).astype(np.float64).mean(-1)/255,
          'ISO100 AHD camera green':a['reference_rgb'][0,1,y:y+h,x:x+w].astype(np.float64)}
 for label,values in sources.items():
  assert values.shape==(160,160)
  yy,xx=np.mgrid[-1:1:160j,-1:1:160j];basis=np.stack([np.ones_like(xx),xx,yy],-1).reshape(-1,3)
  residual=values-(basis@np.linalg.lstsq(basis,values.ravel(),rcond=None)[0]).reshape(160,160)
  power=np.abs(np.fft.fft2(residual*np.outer(np.hanning(160),np.hanning(160))))**2
  fy,fx=np.meshgrid(np.fft.fftfreq(160),np.fft.fftfreq(160),indexing='ij')
  radius=np.hypot(fy,fx);valid=(fy>1/64)&(np.abs(fx)>1/64)&(radius>.0625)&(radius<.4)
  peaks=[]
  for sign in [1,-1]:
   selected=valid & (np.sign(fx)==sign);indices=np.argsort(np.where(selected,power,-1).ravel())[-12:][::-1]
   entries=[]
   for i in indices:
    native=np.array([fy.ravel()[i],fx.ravel()[i]])
    packed=(2*native+.5)%1-.5;r=float(np.linalg.norm(packed))
    rise=np.clip((r-1/32)/(1/32),0,1);fall=np.clip((.45-r)/.05,0,1)
    band=float(np.sin(np.pi*rise/2)**2*np.sin(np.pi*fall/2)**2)
    entries.append({'native_frequency_yx':native.tolist(),'packed_frequency_yx':packed.tolist(),
     'packed_radial_frequency':r,'nominal_smooth_band_gain':band,'spectral_power':float(power.ravel()[i])})
   peaks.append({'x_sign':sign,'strongest12':entries})
  records.append({'window':window['name'],'ROI_xywh':window['ROI_xywh'],'reference':label,
   'reference_binding':binding if 'JPEG' in label else c['arrays'],'peaks_by_diagonal_family':peaks})
assert len(records)==4
# Only summarize the strongest member of each fixed sign family;retain all12.
assert all(v['strongest12'][0]['nominal_smooth_band_gain']==1 for r in records for v in r['peaks_by_diagonal_family'])
output=repo/'docs/results/mesh-band-coverage-20261107-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'completed-fixed-native-reference-frequency-diagnostic','case':c,'records':records,
 'strongest_both_diagonal_families_all_four_reference_windows_inside_full_nominal_band':True,
 'method':'Native160x160,no resize. Separate JPEG mean encoded-sRGB and independent AHD camera-green analyses;least-squares affine detrend,2D Hann window,full FFT. Search positive fy>1/64,abs(fx)>1/64,radial1/16..0.4,separately by fx sign;retain12strongest bins per family. Nominal packed mapping wrap(2*f_native) with inherited smooth radial band1/32..0.45;this proxy omits actual overlapping256-frame taper,phase mixing,support and Malvar response.',
 'inference':'The dominant diagonal reference frequencies are inside the full nominal band in both windows/references,so the upper cutoff is not a convincing explanation for loss of their fundamentals. Some higher harmonics fall outside. This does not identify a trained-path cause or establish that widening the band cannot help. The unrestricted direct RGB path also exists. References differ in aperture,exposure,motion,rendering and coordinates;qualitative,not exactGT. JPEG/AHD powers are not directly comparable,not noisy-input confidence and not model-quality scores. No V165 change or new architecture selected.',
 'current_band_source':ref(repo/'src/demosaic/late_spectral_detail.py'),
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_neural_forwards':0,'new_sensor_sampler_calls':0,
 'original_or_dataz_reads':0,'pixels_resized':False,'new_training_source_constructions':0})
